svg.desc: A vector summary separating indexed source text, NUGGS interpretation, and blocked claims.
svg.text: NUGGS — DTSchB source decision map
Tierschutzwidriges Zubehör (publisher edition shown as June 2024)
SUPPORTED BY INDEXED PRIMARY-PDF TEXT
“Kunststoffröhren” are acceptable only when all three conditions hold:
≤ 2 × animal body length AND adequate ventilation AND instructions against misuse
The search index truncates the sentence ending; complete PDF context remains unread.
NUGGS INTERPRETATION
Generic plural “Kunststoffröhren” supports
applying the limit to tubes, not an explicit
sum of an entire connected system.
Confidence: supportive, not yet document-complete.
NOT ESTABLISHED BY THE EXCERPT
• NUGGS RUN and break definitions
• treatment of couplings or connected tubes
• the claimed 7 cm entrance/bore rule
Blocked pending an end-to-end PDF reading.
PRODUCT-MANAGER ACTION
Keep N2 at 2 × body length and keep length joined to ventilation and instructions.
Retain “scope PROVISIONAL”; do not publish branches/loops as source-cleared yet.
Replace this evidence package with page-faithful PDF + Markdown when the binary is available.
Repository source: docs/nuggs-sources/tierschutzwidriges-zubehoer.md
